direct_source_crosscheck.stern_finding: handoff() durably creates entityos_arbeitspaket and a deterministic capsule but explicitly does not delegate/spawn a child itself.
direct_source_crosscheck.hooks_finding: the donor plugin registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd and PreCompact; it does not itself register SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated or TaskCompleted.

confirmed: SubagentStart fires when an Agent-tool subagent is spawned and exposes unique agent_id plus agent_type.
TaskCreated/TaskCompleted expose task_id in a separate TaskCreate/TaskUpdate lifecycle; documentation does not define task_id as agent_id.
PreToolUse/PostToolUse carry call-scoped tool_use_id; PostToolUse additionally carries tool_response whose schema is tool-specific.
plugin/settings hooks also run inside subagents, and subagent tool-hook input carries agent_id/agent_type, giving a deterministic identity for tool calls performed by an already-started child.
completed resumable subagents expose an agent ID and resume under the same agent ID; therefore run/generation identity must remain separate from long-lived agent identity.
still_unproven: the exact installed Claude Code build and enabled hook composition on the target host
the exact Agent PostToolUse tool_response schema on that installed build
a documented stable shared key directly joining the parent Agent tool_use_id to the spawned SubagentStart agent_id
whether TaskCreated/TaskCompleted participates in the ordinary donor delegation path

architecture_effect.purpose: close durable workpackage -> native child execution -> result re-entry provenance without inventing joins from timing or session order

identity_domains.parent_session_id: context identity only; never sufficient execution identity
identity_domains.spawn_tool_use_id: parent call-scoped Agent invocation identity when observed
identity_domains.agent_id: native Claude Code subagent identity when observed
identity_domains.agent_run_generation: run/resume generation beneath an agent_id; required because one agent_id may resume
identity_domains.task_id: optional independent Task-system identity only when an actual TaskCreate/TaskUpdate lifecycle is observed
identity_domains.child_tool_use_id: call-scoped identity for each tool executed inside the child
identity_domains.result_receipt_id: typed immutable child result/completion receipt identity

minimum_record.agent_run_generation: observed/derived only from deterministic lifecycle, else UNKNOWN
minimum_record.task_id: optional; absent/UNKNOWN is valid for ordinary subagents
minimum_record.spawn_request_digest: required once a spawn request is observed

join_law: never join by timestamp proximity, list order, session_id alone, agent type/name alone or narrative similarity
task_id and agent_id are distinct namespaces and must not be coerced into one field
if no deterministic parent Agent-call -> child agent_id key is observed, keep that edge UNKNOWN rather than synthesizing closure
child tool events may bind directly to agent_id when the runtime emits agent_id in hook common fields
resuming an existing subagent preserves agent_id but creates a new run; therefore agent_run_generation must distinguish executions
reconcile success requires a typed result receipt bound to the exact WorkExecutionBinding, not merely package text plus a plausible result

contradictions_preserved: Donor governance expects handoff -> spawn -> reconcile, while live handoff code explicitly does not spawn.
Official current docs expose child lifecycle identities, but the donor plugin does not register those lifecycle hooks itself and host/global settings may still add them.
Current docs prove agent_id for SubagentStart and task_id for Task lifecycle separately, but do not by themselves prove the parent Agent tool_use_id -> agent_id join.
A host-private or transcript-derived binding may already exist outside the repository; this remains unobserved rather than denied.

required_actions: preserve entityos_arbeitspaket as durable work-intent provenance but do not treat paket_id existence as execution proof
capture SubagentStart/SubagentStop on the installed target only through the build/verification lane and bind agent_id explicitly
capture Agent PreToolUse/PostToolUse with spawn_tool_use_id and inspect the exact installed tool_response before defining the parent-child join
treat TaskCreated/TaskCompleted as optional independent evidence rather than a mandatory alias for subagent identity
record agent run/resume generation separately from agent_id
require typed result receipt binding before reconcile can promote delegated work to verified completion
add concurrency tests with at least two overlapping Agent invocations so timing/order joins fail visibly
